description: Java entity class representing customer options in an e-commerce system, including fields for code, type, descriptions, and associations with merchant store and descriptions.

classes.name: CustomerOption
classes.description: Entity class representing customer options with attributes for code, type, status, descriptions, and associations with merchant store.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Returns the set of descriptions for this customer option.

methods.name: setDescriptions
methods.description: Sets the descriptions for this customer option.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the customer option.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the customer option.

methods.name: getMerchantStore
methods.description: Returns the merchant store associated with this option.

methods.name: setMerchantStore
methods.description: Associates a merchant store with this customer option.

methods.name: getDescriptionsList
methods.description: Returns the descriptions as a list.

methods.name: getDescriptionsSettoList
methods.description: Converts descriptions set to list if necessary, providing a list of descriptions.

methods.name: getCustomerOptionType
methods.description: Returns the type/category of the customer option.

methods.name: setCustomerOptionType
methods.description: Sets the type/category of the customer option.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the code of the customer option.

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets the code for the customer option.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Checks if the option is active.

methods.name: setActive
methods.description: Sets whether the option is active.

methods.name: isPublicOption
methods.description: Checks if the option is public.

methods.name: setPublicOption
methods.description: Sets the option as public or not.
